The nitrogen already bonded to H.

fields.label: b · protonated resonance forms

One nitrogen loses H while the other gains H in each resonance step.
The added H attaches to carbon and the ring gains a negative charge.

fields.label: b · deprotonated resonance forms

options: Neither nitrogen bears H; the negative charge alternates between the two nitrogens as the double bond to their shared carbon switches.
The negative charge remains only on the carbon that gains the removed hydrogen.
Both nitrogens gain positive charges with no compensating negative charge.
fields.explanation: Deprotonation leaves the N–H bonding pair on nitrogen. Donation of that pair into the adjacent C–N bond and movement of the other C=N pair gives the second -1 contributor.
